QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Once Bitten, Twice Zombied
QuestInfo.0: The Maid stuck in the Haunted Mansion basement needs some help.
QuestInfo.1: The Maid was bitten by a zombie and she needs vaccine. She believes that Emperor Zombora stole it from the Masked Gentleman's medicine cabinet.\nShe's running out of time, so you should probably hurry it up.
QuestInfo.2: You got the vaccine back from Emperor Zombora and saved the Maid!

0.0: This is the worst job I've ever had! The temp agency was all like, 'Oh, it'll be so much fun! You just clean up around the party and have fun,' but did they tell me about the ZOMBIES?! No. They did not. First one of them bites me, then it has the NERVE to ask for my number. Isn't that ridiculous?

yes.0: I probably have about 30 minutes before I go full-on zombie. If you could make that not happen, I'd appreciate it.

no.0: Ugh. This was totally not worth 10 mesos an hour.

1.0: Finally. I was thinking about eating... brraaaaiiiiinnnnssss....

yes.0: What was that? Why do I feel the need to start breakdancing in a red jacket? I gotta get out of here.

item.0: Brrraaaiiinnsss...\nNo, I don't like the sound of that at all. Go get that vaccine back from Emperor Zombora before I turn into a stupid zombie!
